objective: Test whether a small, runtime-fused LayerCake bridge trained on naturally written, domain-filtered teacher responses can repair the measured novel English failure without changing the fast three-block execution graph.

context_accounting.claim: The record remains provenance-accounted, but its tail is not claimed as supervised. No prompt is truncated and every record contributes at least one response target.

implementation.focused_pretraining_result: 53 passed; one immutable v4 implementation-certificate hash mismatch expected after cross-vault compose implementation and reserved for a successor certificate

hardware_policy.cpu_role: Teacher-free LayerCake functional evaluation, throughput, TTFO, RSS, identity, and physical-sparse certification only.

validation_order: Run one non-candidate CUDA stress update and require explicit cuda metadata, bounded peak GPU memory, parent immutability, and source absence.
Run exactly one candidate with the locked command and require all fourteen capabilities to be sampled and every successful optimizer step to be accounted.
Evaluate the raw teacher-free LayerCake checkpoint on the disclosed 28-prompt natural audit using the locked no-repeat-four decoder.
Only on a material natural improvement, export the exact fused native runtime and reverify canonical ABI identity, teacher absence, and physical sparse execution.

Run the 1,400-observation broad capability suite, then independent natural validation, paired teacher comparison, repeated CPU speed/TTFO/RSS, three seeds or fresh hosts, package identity, isolation, and untouched final evidence.
decision_rule: Reject the candidate if CUDA stress fails, natural neural generation does not materially improve beyond v21's 4/28, collapse returns, broad retention is unacceptable, the runtime graph changes, or the CPU speed gate fails. Do not tune rank, learning rate, steps, seed, or decoding on the observed candidate.
